reviews.text:
I’ve been really enjoying this sun stick! It has a lightweight, smooth texture that glides effortlessly over the skin without feeling greasy or sticky. The soft matte finish helps control excess oil while keeping my skin comfortable throughout the day.

I love that it’s waterproof and provides high SPF50+ PA++++ protection, making it perfect for outdoor activities and easy sunscreen reapplication. It layers well over makeup without feeling heavy and is very convenient to carry in my bag.

The formula with Centella Asiatica and Vitamin E helps keep my skin feeling calm and protected, while the antioxidant ingredients provide extra care. It doesn’t leave a white cast and works well on my skin.

Overall, this is a practical, effective, and travel-friendly sunscreen stick that I would happily repurchase.
reviews.zh:
我一直好享受呢款防曬棒！質地輕盈順滑，推開去好順暢，唔會油膩或者黏手。柔和嘅霧面效果有助控制多餘油脂，令我全日都舒服。

我好鍾意佢防水，又有 SPF50+ PA++++ 高效防曬，好啱戶外活動，亦方便補擦防曬。搽喺化妝上面都好服貼，唔會覺得厚重，放喺袋入面都好方便攜帶。

配方含有積雪草同維他命 E，令皮膚感覺平靜同受保護，而抗氧化成分就提供額外護理。佢唔會留低白色痕跡，喺我皮膚上都好好用。

整體嚟講，呢款係一款實用、有效而且方便旅行攜帶嘅防曬棒，我會樂意再買。

reviews.text:
I am absolutely loving the TOCOBO Vita Waterproof Sun Stick! It has completely upgraded my sun protection routine, especially for hot days or when I'm on the move.

The SPF50+ PA++++ protection gives me total peace of mind, and the waterproof formula means it actually holds up against sweat. It glides onto my skin effortlessly without leaving any sticky residue or an annoying white cast. Plus, the compact stick design makes it incredibly easy to toss in my bag and reapply throughout the day without messing up my skin. It's definitely a summer must have
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意 TOCOBO Vita Waterproof Sun Stick！佢令我嘅防曬流程全面升級，特別係天氣炎熱或者外出嗰陣。

SPF50+ PA++++ 防護令我非常安心，而防水配方就令佢真係可以抵住汗水。佢推開去好順滑，唔會留低任何黏膩殘留，亦冇令人討厭嘅白色痕跡。另外，細細枝嘅設計令我好容易放入袋入面，全日都可以補擦，唔會弄花皮膚。絕對係夏天必備！

reviews.text: This Waterproof Sun Stick is my favorite sunscreen product. I love that it is water-resistant, so I use it at the beach because it stays on my skin much better than regular sunscreen. It also means less product washes off into the sea, which I really appreciate. Since it lasts longer, I don't have to reapply it too often. Another great advantage is its compact size. It fits perfectly in my bag, and I can apply sun protection anytime without getting my hands messy. I really hate having sunscreen cream on my hands, so this stick is the perfect solution for me🥰
reviews.zh: 呢款 Waterproof Sun Stick 係我最愛嘅防曬產品。我好鍾意佢防水，所以我去海灘都用佢，因為佢比普通防曬更能夠留喺皮膚上。咁樣亦即係少啲產品被沖落海，我好欣賞呢點。因為持久力較長，所以唔使太頻密咁補擦。另一個好處係佢細細件，好啱放入袋，隨時都可以搽防曬，又唔使弄得雙手都黏。我真係好憎手上有防曬霜，所以呢款防曬棒對我嚟講係完美嘅解決方案🥰

reviews.text: This sun stick is incredibly convenient for reapplication throughout the day. It glides smoothly over the skin without disturbing makeup and leaves a natural finish instead of a heavy, greasy layer. I love keeping it in my bag for touch-ups when I’m outdoors. The lightweight texture and ease of use make sun protection effortless. A must-have for anyone who struggles to reapply sunscreen regularly.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬棒全日補擦非常方便。推開去好順滑，唔會弄花化妝，留低嘅係自然嘅效果，而唔係厚重油膩嘅一層。我好鍾意放喺袋入面，喺戶外時用嚟補擦。質地輕盈、用起嚟容易，令防曬變得毫不費力。對於經常都忘記補擦防曬嘅人嚟講，呢款係必備品。

reviews.text:
This sun stick is a game-changer for hot days and outdoor activities! It’s lightweight, non-greasy, and the waterproof formula actually stays put even when sweating. I love that it leaves no white cast and gives the skin a healthy, subtle glow without feeling sticky. It also has a lovely, refreshing citrus scent.

It is super easy to reapply on the go and fits perfectly in my bag. If you need a reliable, water-resistant sun stick that protects and brightens, this is the one! Highly recommend!
reviews.zh:
呢款防曬棒令我嘅炎熱天氣同戶外活動徹底改變！佢輕盈、唔油膩，防水配方即使出汗都真係留得住。我好鍾意佢唔會留低白色痕跡，又可以令皮膚有健康、自然嘅光澤，唔會覺得黏。佢仲有好清新嘅柑橘香味。

外出時補擦超級方便，又好啱放入袋入面。如果你需要一款可靠、防水嘅防曬棒，又可以保護同提亮皮膚，就係呢款！非常推薦！

reviews.text: This sun stick has a lovely matte formula. It hasn’t stung my eyes which makes it very comfortable to apply and not have to worry about watering eyes. At first the shape of the bar is a bit uncomfortable, but with usage it smoothes to a comfortable shape. I can’t really share how it goes over make up, I have used it for days when I know I will be spending a long time outside hence the need to reapply sunscreen is present. So far it has served it’s purpose and I haven’t acquired a sunburn on my face.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬棒嘅霧面配方好好。佢冇刺痛我嘅眼睛，所以搽起嚟好舒服，唔使擔心眼睛流眼水。起初個棒身形狀有少少唔舒服，但用得多之後，就會磨到一個舒服嘅形狀。至於疊喺化妝上嘅效果，我未有好多心得，因為我只係喺要長時間外出嘅日子先用，所以需要補擦防曬。到目前為止，佢已經達到目的，我面都冇曬傷。

reviews.text:
I’ve been really enjoying the TOCOBO Sun Stick. First, it's Waterproof, no need to renew each time after swelling!

What I love most is that I don’t have to get my hands messy when applying it. The stick format is incredibly convenient, especially when I’m on the go or don’t have access to a sink. It feels light on the skin, leaves no greasy residue, and provides reliable protection throughout the day. Overall, it’s a very practical and user-friendly sunscreen that I’m happy to use daily.
reviews.zh:
我一直好享受 TOCOBO Sun Stick。首先，佢係防水嘅，唔使每次流汗之後都要重新搽！

我最鍾意嘅係搽嘅時候唔使弄污雙手。棒狀設計非常方便，特別係外出嗰陣，或者冇水龍頭嗰陣。搽落皮膚上好輕，唔會有油膩殘留，全日都可以提供可靠嘅保護。整體嚟講，呢款係非常實用、易用嘅防曬產品，我好樂意每日都用。

reviews.text:
It's a great product! 💛

I usually only buy sun sticks that are transparent, because I was afraid others would either leave a white cast or would ruin my makeup, however this sun stick has performed well over makeup and worn by itself as well. 
It's hydrating on the dry areas,not oily over oily skin areas and it's colorless. 
I use it on my neck and hands as well and it leaves a hydrating effect without being greasy.
reviews.zh:
係一款好好嘅產品！💛

我通常只會買透明嘅防曬棒，因為我擔心其他嘅會留低白色痕跡，或者弄花我嘅化妝；不過呢款防曬棒疊喺化妝上效果好好，單獨用都好好。
佢喺乾嘅位置會保濕，唔會喺油嘅位置再加油，而且係無色嘅。
我都用喺頸同手上，佢會留低保濕效果，唔會油膩。
